related_questions.question: What are the side effects of the 5th COVID booster?
related_questions.snippet: Common side effects include pain at the injection site, fever, body aches and headaches. These reactions are frequent (and indicate that your body is making an immune response to the vaccine) and should go away within 1-2 days, with the exception that swollen lymph nodes may persist up to about 10 days.

related_questions.question: How effective is the 4th COVID booster?
related_questions.snippet: The latest findings show that fourth dose mRNA booster vaccines for Covid are well-tolerated in people who received Pfizer as a third dose. They are also effective at increasing both antibody and cellular immunity up to and above baseline and peak levels observed following third dose boosters.

related_questions.question: When will the new COVID vaccine be available in 2025?

text_blocks.snippet: The updated COVID-19 vaccine for the 2025-2026 formula will be available in the fall of 2025. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) met on May 22, 2025, to recommend a monovalent JN.1-lineage vaccine composition. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is expected to update their recommendations to align with the new formula, with the CDC recommending a 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccine for most adults 18 and older and parents of children ages 6 months and older according to the CDC.
